definitions.name: O3A.DEPTH
definitions.body: 'O3A.DS' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD 'O3A.DR' BIND O3A.DS CHARS [ 'O3A.DK' BIND O3A.DR O3A.DK GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest number of brackets open at once (running open-minus-close count, never below 0); 0 for empty

definitions.name: O3A.BPREFIX
definitions.body: G0A.BSCAN 'O3A.PS' BIND '#' 1 COLLECT O3A.PS CONCAT 'O3A.PV' BIND O3A.PV O1A.IDX 0 O3A.PV [ '#' EQ ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty prefix is); uses G0A.BSCAN, O1A.IDX

definitions.name: O3A.FFILL
definitions.body: 'O3A.FV' BIND O3A.FV O3A.FV O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ G0B.FILLSTEP ] SCAN
definitions.note: V with NILs (at least one present) -> forward-filled V, leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: O3A.TAGS-OF
definitions.body: 'tags' GET 'O3A.TG' BIND O3A.TG [ ] 2 COLLECT 0 1 O3A.TG NIL? NOT SELECT GET UNIQUE
definitions.note: order Record -> Vector of its distinct tags, empty when it has no tags key

definitions.name: O3A.TAG-COUNTS
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it, first-appearance order

definitions.name: O3A.UNPRICED
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> distinct skus of orders without a price, first-appearance order
